title: Grateful Dead Live at Eagle's Auditorium on 1968-01-27
lineage: SBD > MR > DAT > PCM > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of the early‑68 Spanish Jam – decent sound but a bit choppy, with a mixed‑quality jam that some find wicked while others call it uninspired.
ai_review.review: The tape captures a solitary Spanish Jam from the Dead’s first Seattle tour in January 1968. Listeners note the soundboard source is generally clear though there is noticeable feedback and a slightly choppy texture, and the mix pushes the bass forward. Musically the jam elicits split opinions – a few rave about a wild guitar eruption around 5:10, while others find it average compared to other early‑68 Spanish Jams.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is mixed (average to good) and recording quality is generally good but with some issues; weighted average yields a mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall fine sound quality, but some reviewers mention feedback that hurts the mix and a slightly choppy texture; bass is unusually high in the mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Only a single jam fragment is present, making it hard to assess overall set structure.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar work described as a "crazy ass" jam that some find wicked, though others view the jam as uninspired.
